docs.text: IA School Map Pathfinder This site is the GitHub Pages front door for the school pathfinder project. The interactive map is a Textual Python app. Textual can be wrapped for the browser with textual-serve , but it still needs a live Python web server. GitHub Pages can host this page, but it cannot run the Python app process. Run Locally ./.venv/bin/python serve.py Then open: http://127.0.0.1:8000 Public Deployment Deploy the Python app to a service that can run python serve.py , such as Render, Railway, Fly.io, or a VPS. After it has a public URL, link to that URL from this page. The included render.yaml is a ready-to-use Render web service config.
